# sonarqube_alm_bitbucket_cloud (Data Source)

Looks up a Bitbucket Cloud DevOps platform setting. Its secrets are not readable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_alm_bitbucket_cloud" "main" {
  key = "bitbucket-cloud"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the setting.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OAuth consumer key.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `workspace` (String) Bitbucket Cloud workspace ID.
